newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania's Cereol invests in Austria.
newsitem.headline: Eridania's Cereol invests in Austria.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say said on Friday that its Cereol Holding BV unit will buy a 50 percent stake in Austrian oilseed processor Olmuhle Bruck from Austrian holding OSAT for an undisclosed amount.
OSAT currently controls 100 percent of Olmuhle.
In a statement Eridania Beghin-Say said Cereol will pay for the acquisition in cash, equipment and know how.
Olmuhle had sales of 700 million Austrian schillings (50 million Ecus).
The deal is subject to approval by EU authorities, which is expected shortly.
It will raise the oilseeds crushing capacity of Olmuhle to 250,000 tonnes per year from 180,000 tonnes.
Installations will be completed for the crushing of the harvest of summer 1998.
Cereol also plans to further expand Olmuhle Bruck, building a new refinery.
Cereol is the European division of the crushing and refining business of Eridania Beghin-Say. It operates more than 30 oilseeeds crushings plants and refineries in Europe and in the United States.
